```{r}
library(tidyverse)
sapply(select(mtcars, c(mpg, cyl)), mean)

mtcars |> select(mpg, cyl) |> sapply(mean)

```

length() -> returns the number of elements in the vector (including duplicates)
unique() -> returns a vector containing only the distinct values, removing any duplicates while keeping the original order
sort() -> returns the vector with its elements ordered (in increasing numerical order)
paste() -> converts the numbers to character strings and concatenates them together into a single character vector
